subject: prd/impl-review
statement: Before coordinated parent activation the compatibility path performs zero pre-invocation network I/O; after activation every pass-routing terminal is canonically appended and exact-read before selected review-model invocation or process-result use, with no other network operation in that interval, and the complete git/proposal evidence then round-trips losslessly.
fit_criterion: pre-parent zero-network trace; post-parent append/exact-read ordering traces; zero-evidence and evidence-store-outage failures; git/GitHub/Carina golden round-trips plus overwrite and mismatch defects
